speaker: Doctor
text:
The low reticulocyte count indicates bone marrow hypoplasia rather than peripheral destruction, and with normal B12/folate and negative infectious workup, I suspect Diamond-Blackfan Anemia. I will request a final test to confirm the diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal adenine nucleotide level rules out Diamond-Blackfan Anemia, and with normal B12, folate, and rubella serology, the most likely cause of this infant's macrocytic anemia and apnea is a delayed fall in fetal hemoglobin due to prematurity, known as Physiologic Anemia of Prematurity.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiologic Anemia of Prematurity
